title: Why Join This Club?
subtitle: Discover how being part of CODEX accelerates your journey from student to high-caliber software engineer.

cards.title: Learn
cards.description: Learn modern technologies through practical experience, deep-dive workshops, and industry standard code review practices.

cards.title: Build
cards.description: Build real-world projects that solve genuine campus and community problems, moving far beyond theoretical assignments.

cards.title: Collaborate
cards.description: Work with passionate peers, designers, and senior engineers in agile multi-disciplinary squads.

cards.title: Compete
cards.description: Participate in national coding competitions, 24-hour hackathons, and algorithmic programming contests.

cards.title: Explore
cards.description: Explore AI, Web, 3D, Cloud and emerging technologies before they hit mainstream textbooks.

cards.title: Grow
cards.description: Develop technical and professional skills with resume building, mock interviews, and strong alumni network support.
